UserStudyProfile.title: User Study Profile
UserStudyProfile.description: Metadata about the user's study preferences and linked external accounts. Access is restricted to self and admins.

credentials.description: Academic or professional titles (e.g. PhD, MDiv, Seminary Student).

bio.description: A brief scholarly biography explaining research interests.

isAdmin.description: System administration privilege. Can only be granted by another admin.

isTrustedContributor.description: Privilege to bypass peer review for posts.

modelProvider.description: Whether to use cloud-based Google AI or locally hosted models.

selectedModel.description: The specific model name (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash, llama3).

customApiKey.description: The user's personal Google AI API key. Encrypted at rest.

ollamaUrl.description: Custom endpoint for local Ollama inference.

WikiEntry.title: Wiki Entry
WikiEntry.description: A scholarly wiki article requiring citations and moderation.

BlogPost.title: Blog Post
BlogPost.description: A reflective or narrative scholarly blog post.

category.description: The primary scholarly category of the post.

BlogComment.title: Blog Comment
BlogComment.description: A scholar's comment on a blog post.

SystemSettings.title: System Settings
SystemSettings.description: Global application configuration. Read/Write restricted to authenticated System Administrators only.

localModelList.description: A list of locally available models via Ollama.

/users/{userId}.description: User's study profile and role flags. Access restricted to OWNER or ADMIN.

/system/config.description: Global system configuration. Access restricted to ADMIN.

/wiki_entries/{entryId}.description: Scholarly wiki articles. PUBLIC READ, MODERATOR WRITE.

/blog_posts/{postId}.description: Scholarly blog posts. PUBLIC READ, MODERATOR WRITE.

/blog_posts/{postId}/comments/{commentId.description: Comments on a blog post. PUBLIC READ, AUTHENTICATED WRITE.
